build_combined_module: build a CombinedModule that wraps a transform and model for text inference
run_forward_inference: run forward inference on raw text input through the CombinedModule to get generated output
generate_text_tokens: generate text tokens from a conditioning sequence using temperature sampling and top-k filtering
set_device_torch: set the device string on a CombinedModule instance for TorchScript export compatibility
review_top_k_logits: review the top_k_logits method that filters logits by keeping only the top k values
